# pyMetadataEditor

> Python client library for the [Metadata Editor](https://github.com/mah0001/metadata-editor) REST API. It lets data curators create, retrieve, update, and manage structured metadata for research datasets across ten data types (microdata, indicators, indicators_db, geospatial, documents, scripts, images, videos, tables, resources), with LLM-powered automatic metadata generation, admin-metadata CRUD, user lookup, and collection permission management.

The public API is a single class, ``MetadataEditor`` (from ``pymetadataeditor``), that wraps the REST API. Every metadata method accepts an ``output_mode`` of ``"dict"``, ``"pydantic"``, or ``"excel"``. Errors raised against the Metadata Editor API are translated into a semantic exception hierarchy rooted at ``MetadataEditorAPIError`` (itself a subclass of ``requests.exceptions.HTTPError``).

Start with the getting-started guide and the agent skill, then dive into user-guide topics as needed. The API reference page is auto-generated from source docstrings by mkdocstrings and is always current.
